title: Enterprise Bootstrap Theme
description:
Components of the Enterprise Bootstrap Theme, plus the A2UI basic catalog's components and functions, which this catalog re-exports. Every data property accepts a literal, a {"path": …} binding or a {"call": …} function call to one of this catalog's functions; a <request>Result property accepts only a binding. Each event a component emits has an on<Event> action property. A component whose events or requests carry a payload has one binding-only eventData property: bind it to a path, and the component writes each event's payload to <path>/<channel>, and each request to <path>/<request>, before sending the matching action, so read that path in the action's context; the context is resolved after the write. A request's on<Request> action asks you for data: answer with updateDataModel at the path bound to its <request>Result property, with a value matching the $defs entry its description names, once per request. A two-way value property receives the user's changes at its bound path. Some two-way components also send an action when the value changes; that action carries no payload of its own, so read the new value through the path bound to value.

- ActionItems: Action Items. Show action items the user adds, edits, nests, reorders, assigns and moves through statuses; a new item first comes as itemCreate with empty content, then itemUpdate carries its text. For a table of typed records use DataGrid, and for a read-only list of events ActivityFeed; when rewriting items, include every item you heard about, or the user's unfinished new item is dropped.
- ActivityFeed: Activity Feed. Show a timeline of who did what and when, grouped by day; the agent hears clicks on an event, its actor or its target. For a log of technical messages use LogConsole; for alerts the user must act on use NotificationCenter. Use it to browse, monitor a collection of 1 to 2000 items.
- AnglePicker: Angle Picker. Let the user set an angle in degrees with a dial, such as a rotation or a gradient direction. For a plain number on a scale use RangeSlider; for a typed number use TextField.
- AuditLogViewer: Audit Log Viewer. Show an audit trail of who changed what, with severity, filters and paging; the agent hears which entry the user opens. For a running log of messages use LogConsole; for a social timeline use ActivityFeed. Use it to browse, inspect a collection of 1 to 50000 items.
- Breadcrumb: Breadcrumb. Show where the user is in a hierarchy as a trail of links, with actions on the last segment; the agent hears each click. For switching between sibling views use Tabs; for browsing a whole hierarchy use TreeView.
- ChartPanel: Chartpanel. Show numbers as a bar, line, area or sparkline chart across categories, with a legend and axes. For one value against a target use Gauge; for one number with a trend use MetricCard. Use it to monitor, compare, summarize a timeseries of 2 to 5000 items.
- ChatDock: ChatDock. Show a running conversation with a message input, so the user can talk to the agent inside the surface. For a single free-text answer use TextField; for a static transcript use List with Text.
- CodeEditor: Code Editor. Let the user read or edit code with syntax highlighting, line numbers and a toolbar; Ctrl+S saves. For prose use RichTextInput; for a LaTeX expression use LatexEditor. Use it to edit, author a document of exactly 1 item.
- ColorPicker: Color Picker. Let the user pick any colour, with a palette, a colour field and hex or RGB entry. For a drawing tool's stroke and fill use ToolColorPicker; for a gradient use GradientPicker.
- ColumnsPicker: Columns Picker. Let the user choose how many text columns a page or section uses, from presets that preview it. For page margins use MarginsPicker; for paper size use SizesPicker.
- Conversation: Conversation. Show a full chat panel between the user and the agent, with markdown replies the user can rate; answer each message by writing the whole session, your reply included. For a compact docked chat with branching turns use ChatDock; for a log of system output use LogConsole; for markdown the user edits use MarkdownEditor.
- CronPicker: CRON Picker. Let the user build a recurring schedule as a CRON expression, with presets and a readable summary. For a single date use DatePicker; for a length of time use DurationPicker.
- DataGrid: Data Grid. Show rows of records in sortable, pageable columns the user can select, open and edit; the agent hears each. For a hierarchy of rows use TreeGrid; for a short list of items use List. Use it to browse, compare, edit a collection of 2 to 100000 items.
- DatePicker: Date Picker. Let the user pick one calendar date from a popup calendar, with optional limits. For a date and a time use DateTimeInput; for a fiscal month or quarter use PeriodPicker. Use it to edit, schedule a scalar of exactly 1 item.
- DocViewer: Doc Viewer. Show multi-page documentation written in markdown, with a table of contents, an outline and previous and next links. For one short piece of text use Text; for switching between a few panels use Tabs. Use it to browse, inspect a document of 1 to 500 items.
- DurationPicker: Duration Picker. Let the user enter a length of time in units such as days, hours and minutes. For a time of day use TimePicker; for a recurring schedule use CronPicker.
- DynamicFormSwitcher: Dynamic Form Switcher. Show a form whose fields the agent defines, optionally in several variants the user switches between; read the values from eventData. For one or two inputs use TextField or ChoicePicker; for a fixed set of choices use ChoicePicker. Use it to edit, author a record of exactly 1 item.
- EditableComboBox: Editable Combo Box. Let the user type freely or pick from a filtered list of suggestions in one field. To choose only from a fixed list use ChoicePicker; for a search query use SearchBox.
- EmptyState: Empty State. Fill an empty view with an icon, a heading, a short explanation and up to two buttons, such as Create project. For a loading placeholder use SkeletonLoader; for a single call to action without the empty message use Button. Use it to browse a collection of exactly 0 items.
- ExplorerPicker: Explorer Picker. Let the user browse and search a folder tree and pick items to link or attach; you answer each folder's children and, if you bind onSearch, each search. To pick from a short flat list use ChoicePicker; for a tree the user only browses or edits use TreeView or TreeGrid.
- FacetSearch: Facet Search. Let the user search with free text plus key:value filters picked from known facets; the agent hears each search. For plain text search use SearchBox; for picking from a fixed list use ChoicePicker.
- FontDropdown: Font Dropdown. Let the user choose a font family from a list that previews each font in its own typeface. For choices that are not fonts use ChoicePicker; for a free-text font name use TextField.
- Gauge: Gauge. Show a value against a maximum, a limit or a deadline as a ring, bar or tile gauge with coloured thresholds. For a number with a trend and no scale use MetricCard; for a value the user drags use RangeSlider. Use it to monitor a scalar of exactly 1 item.
- GradientPicker: Gradient Picker. Let the user design a linear or radial colour gradient with stops, an angle and presets. For a single solid colour use ColorPicker.
- GraphLegend: Graph Legend. Explain the node and edge types of a graph or diagram, with colours, icons and optional counts. For a plain key-value list use List with Text; it is not a legend for numeric chart series.
- InlineToolbar: Inline Toolbar. Show a compact row of icon buttons and toggles, such as text formatting; the agent hears which one the user pressed. For a single action use Button; for a choice among options use ChoicePicker.
- LatexEditor: LaTeX Editor. Let the user write a LaTeX math expression with a live rendered preview and a symbol palette; Ctrl+Enter confirms. For prose use RichTextInput; for code use CodeEditor.
- LayoutPicker: Layout Picker. Let the user choose an automatic layout algorithm for a graph or diagram, shown as thumbnails. For choices that are not layout algorithms use ChoicePicker.
- LineEndingPicker: Line Ending Picker. Let the user choose an arrowhead or other end marker for a line or connector in a diagram. For a line's dash pattern use LineTypePicker; for its thickness use LineWidthPicker.
- LineShapePicker: Line Shape Picker. Let the user choose the routing shape of a connector in a diagram, such as straight or curved. For a line's dash pattern use LineTypePicker; for its end markers use LineEndingPicker.
- LineTypePicker: Line Type Picker. Let the user choose a line's dash pattern, such as solid, dashed or dotted, with a preview. For a line's thickness use LineWidthPicker; for its routing shape use LineShapePicker.
- LineWidthPicker: Line Width Picker. Let the user choose a line or border thickness from a list that previews each width. For a line's dash pattern use LineTypePicker; for an arbitrary number use Slider.
- LogConsole: Log Console. Show a scrolling log of timestamped messages with level filters, such as a build or job output. For a timeline of user actions use ActivityFeed; for an audit trail use AuditLogViewer.
- MarginsPicker: Margins Picker. Let the user choose page margins from named presets such as Normal, Narrow and Wide. For paper size use SizesPicker; for line and paragraph spacing use SpacingPicker.
- MarkdownEditor: Markdown Editor. Let the user write and preview a markdown document, with a formatting toolbar; Ctrl+Enter saves. For a short formatted note use RichTextInput; to show markdown read-only use DocViewer. Use it to author, edit a document of exactly 1 item.
- MarketingHero: Marketing Hero. Open a page with a large heading, a short supporting paragraph and up to two call-to-action buttons, such as Get started and Read the docs. For an empty view inside an app use EmptyState; for a single headline figure use MetricCard. Use it to browse a document of exactly 1 item.
- MaskedEntry: Masked Entry. Let the user enter a secret such as a password or API key, masked, with reveal and copy. For ordinary text that need not be hidden use TextField.
- MetricCard: Metriccard. Show one key number with its label, an optional trend and secondary text, as a dashboard tile. For a value against a maximum or target use Gauge; for a short status word use StatusBadge. Use it to monitor, summarize a scalar of exactly 1 item.
- NotificationCenter: Notification Center. Show a bell with a list of notifications the user can open, dismiss or mark read; the agent hears each. For a passive timeline use ActivityFeed; for one message use Text or a Modal.
- OrientationPicker: Orientation Picker. Let the user choose portrait or landscape page orientation, shown as two page icons. For any other choice between a few options use ChoicePicker.
- PeoplePicker: People Picker. Let the user find and pick one or more people by name, with each search answered by the agent. For free-form tags use Tagger; for a fixed list of options use ChoicePicker.
- PeriodPicker: Period Picker. Let the user pick a reporting period such as a month, quarter, half or year from a grid. For a single calendar date use DatePicker; for an agile sprint use SprintPicker.
- PersonChip: Person Chip. Show one person compactly with an avatar or initials, a name and a presence dot; the user can click it. For several people at once use PresenceIndicator; to let the user pick people use PeoplePicker. Use it to summarize a record of exactly 1 item.
- Pill: Pill. Show a compact tag, filter or mention that the user can click, or dismiss to remove it. For a status with a colour meaning use StatusBadge; for a person with an avatar use PersonChip.
- PresenceIndicator: Presence Indicator. Show who is here as a stack of avatars with a count of the rest, which the user can expand into a list. For one person with their name use PersonChip; to let the user pick people use PeoplePicker.
- PromptTemplateManager: Prompt Template Manager. Show a library of prompt templates with {{variable}} placeholders that the user can browse, edit, fill in, duplicate and delete; the agent supplies the templates and hears each select, save, delete and duplicate. For a single free-text prompt use RichTextInput; for code use CodeEditor; set showImportExport to false when the agent must see every template, since imports and exports stay in the browser.
- RangeSlider: Slider. Let the user choose a number, or a low-high range, by dragging along a scale with steps. For an angle use AnglePicker; for a typed number use TextField.
- ReasoningAccordion: Reasoning Accordion. Show an agent’s reasoning as collapsible steps with status, timing and confidence, updated as it thinks. For a plain list of items use List; for sequential tasks the user works through use Stepper.
- RelationshipManager: Relationship Manager. Show the typed links between one resource and others, grouped by type, so the user can add, remove, confirm and open them; the agent answers each target search and rewrites the list. For a hierarchy of parent and child items use TreeView; for tabular records use DataGrid; no event is acknowledged, so answer each one by writing the new relationships.
- RichTextInput: Rich Text Input. Let the user write formatted text with bold, italics, lists and links; with submitOnCtrlEnter, Ctrl+Enter sends it. For plain single-line text use TextField; for long markdown documents use MarkdownEditor.
- Ruler: Ruler. Show a measuring ruler in px, cm, mm or inches beside a canvas or document area. For choosing a number use Slider or TextField; a ruler only displays a scale.
- SearchBox: Search Box. Give the user a search field with suggestions; the agent hears each query and each submit. To pick people use PeoplePicker; to type or pick from a list use EditableComboBox.
- SiteFooter: Site Footer. Close a page with an organization block, contact details, grouped links and a legal row; you hear each link click and open its page yourself. For a trail to the current page use Breadcrumb; for an app's main navigation use Tabs. Use it to browse a collection of 1 to 24 items.
- SizesPicker: Sizes Picker. Let the user choose a paper or page size, such as Letter, Legal or A4, from named presets. For page margins use MarginsPicker; for text columns use ColumnsPicker.
- SkeletonLoader: Skeleton Loader. Hold the place of content that is still loading, shaped like text, a card, an avatar or a table. For a status the user should read use Text; replace the loader as soon as the content arrives.
- SpacingPicker: Spacing Picker. Let the user choose line and paragraph spacing for text from named presets such as Single or Double. For page margins use MarginsPicker; for a free numeric value use Slider.
- SprintPicker: Sprint Picker. Let the user pick an agile sprint from a list computed from a start date and a sprint length. For a fiscal month or quarter use PeriodPicker; for a single calendar date use DatePicker.
- StatusBadge: Status Badge. Show a short status, such as Operational or Degraded, as a coloured badge, optionally clickable for details. For a removable tag or filter use Pill; for a number with a trend use MetricCard.
- Stepper: Stepper. Show the steps of a multi-step task with progress and Back, Next and Finish; the agent hears each step change and shows that step's content. For switching freely between views use Tabs; for a single progress value use Gauge.
- StickyNote: Sticky Note. Let the user write or read one short free-form note, styled as a coloured sticky note. For a labelled form input use TextField; for read-only prose use Text. Use it to author, summarize a document of exactly 1 item.
- SymbolPicker: Symbol Picker. Let the user browse and insert special characters or icons from categorised grids. To show one fixed icon use Icon; to pick from a short list of options use ChoicePicker.
- Tagger: Tagger. Let the user add and remove tags, free-form or from a categorised taxonomy, as chips. To pick people use PeoplePicker; to choose one option from a list use ChoicePicker.
- TenantSwitcher: Tenant Switcher. Let the user switch between the organisations or workspaces they belong to, shown as a trigger with the active one's name and a searchable list. For choosing an option in a form use ChoicePicker; for choosing people use PeoplePicker.
- ThemeToggle: Theme Toggle. Let the user switch the whole page between light, dark and automatic themes; it restyles the host page, not just the surface. For a choice that affects only your own content use ChoicePicker.
- TimePicker: Time Picker. Let the user pick a time of day, in a 12- or 24-hour clock, optionally with a timezone. For a date and time together use DateTimeInput; for a length of time use DurationPicker.
- TimezonePicker: Timezone Picker. Let the user pick an IANA timezone from a searchable list that shows each zone's offset. For a time of day with its own timezone selector use TimePicker.
- ToolColorPicker: Tool Color Picker. Let the user pick a drawing colour for a pen, marker, pencil, highlighter or brush from a small palette. For choosing between named options that are not colours use ChoicePicker.
- TreeGrid: Tree Grid. Show a hierarchy of rows with data columns that the user can expand, select, edit, act on and rearrange; the agent can load children on demand. For a flat table use DataGrid; for a hierarchy of labels without columns use TreeView. Use it to browse, compare a hierarchy of 2 to 50000 items.
- TreeView: Tree View. Show a hierarchy the user browses, expands and selects from, such as folders or categories. For a flat list without nesting use List; to pick one or more options use ChoicePicker. Use it to browse, navigate, inspect a hierarchy of 1 to 20000 items.
- VisualTableEditor: Table Editor. Let the user edit a table of text cells, with rows, columns, merges and styling; the edited table comes back as the value. For rows of typed records use DataGrid; for a form use DynamicFormSwitcher.
- WorkspaceShell: WorkspaceShell. Show several named canvases as tabs the user can select, pin, close or create, with a history scrubber. For simple tabbed content without canvas actions use Tabs.

onRenderCommentSlot, and opens empty without it. Default: true.

itemHoverCardMode.description:
Hover card display mode for item rows (ADR-126).
"builtin" (default) — shows a card with the item's full content,
assignee, status, dates, comment count, and tags.
"custom" — calls `renderItemHoverCard` and uses its return value.
"off" — no hover card.

showInlineToolbar.description:
Mount an InlineToolbar in the panel header offering a secondary
alphabetic sort (asc/desc) of items within each section, plus
expand-all / collapse-all. Default: false (opt-in).
Throws when `window.createInlineToolbar` is not loaded.

content and timestamp, and the transcript re-renders while the user's

feedback.description: The user's rating of this reply. The feedback event tells you of each rating; repeat it here in every later write, or the reply's thumb is shown unrated again.

comment.description: Optional written comment from the user.

updatedAt.description: When the session was last updated.

placeholder.description: Placeholder text for the input textarea.  Default: "Type a message...".

showHeader.description: Show the session header with controls.  Default: true.

title.description: Session title displayed in header.  Default: "Conversation".

showFeedback.description: Show feedback buttons on assistant messages.  Default: true.

showMessageCopy.description: Show copy button on individual messages.  Default: true.

showConversationCopy.description: Show conversation-level copy button in header.  Default: true.

showNewConversation.description: Show the "New conversation" button.  Default: true.

showClearContext.description: Show the "Clear context" button.  Default: true.

showTimestamps.description: Show timestamp on each message.  Default: false.

userAvatar.description: User avatar: Bootstrap Icons class or image URL.

assistantAvatar.description: Assistant avatar: Bootstrap Icons class or image URL.

autoFocus.description: Auto-focus the input field on show().  Default: true.

disabled.description: Disable the input area.  Default: false.

height.description: Height of the component (CSS value).  Default: "100%".

width.description: Width of the component (CSS value).  Default: "100%".

cssClass.description: Additional CSS class(es) on the root element.

showCanvas.description: Show the canvas side panel for full-size MCP apps.  Default: false.

canvasWidth.description: Default canvas panel width in pixels.  Default: 480.

canvasMinWidth.description: Minimum canvas panel width in pixels.  Default: 280.

canvasMaxWidthFraction.description: Maximum canvas width as a fraction of the container.  Default: 0.6.

CronPicker.description: CRON Picker. Let the user build a recurring schedule as a CRON expression, with presets and a readable summary. For a single date use DatePicker; for a length of time use DurationPicker.

value.description: Initial CRON expression. Default: "0 * * * * *" (every minute). Two-way: when bound to a path, the component writes the user's changes there.

showPresets.description: Show the presets dropdown. Default: true.

showDescription.description: Show the human-readable description. Default: true.

showRawExpression.description: Show the raw expression input. Default: true.

allowRawEdit.description: Allow editing the raw expression input. Default: true.

showFormatHint.description: Show the format hint. Default: true.

presets.description: Custom presets to display. Uses default presets when not provided.

disabled.description: When true, the component is disabled. Default: false.

readonly.description: When true, inputs are read-only. Default: false.

keyBindings.description: Override default key combos. Keys are action names, values are combo strings.

mode.description: Display mode. "inline" renders in container, "dropdown" shows as trigger + popup. Default: "inline".

DataGrid.description: Data Grid. Show rows of records in sortable, pageable columns the user can select, open and edit; the agent hears each. For a hierarchy of rows use TreeGrid; for a short list of items use List. Use it to browse, compare, edit a collection of 2 to 100000 items.

columns.description: Column definitions, in display order. Required; the grid throws without it.

rows.description: Initial rows, each { id, data }. Default: none (the empty state shows). Replace later with setRows().

pageSize.description: Rows per page; 0 or less turns paging off and shows every row. Default: 50.

pageSizeOptions.description: Choices offered in the rows-per-page selector. Default: [25, 50, 100, 250].

serverSide.description: True when the rows are one page loaded by the host; set the total with setTotalRowCount(). Default: false.

virtualScrolling.description: Windowed rendering: "enabled" always, "disabled" never, "auto" above 5000 rows on a page. Default: "auto".

selectable.description: Row selection on click: "single", "multi" or "checkbox" (multi plus a checkbox column). Default: off.

showRowNumbers.description: Adds a leading # column of row numbers. Default: false.

showFooter.description: Adds a footer row showing each column's aggregate (see the column's aggregate setting). Default: false.

striped.description: Alternating row shading. Default: true; only an explicit false turns it off.

dense.description: Compact rows (24px instead of 32px). Default: false.

enableColumnReorder.description: Lets the user drag column headers to reorder them. Default: true; only an explicit false turns it off.

externalSort.description: True when the host sorts the rows: the grid reports sorts but does not reorder them itself. Default: false.

externalFilter.description: True when the host filters the rows: the grid reports filters but does not hide rows itself. Default: false.

height.description: CSS height of the scrolling area, such as "300px" or "50vh". Default: "400px".

cssClass.description: Extra CSS classes for the grid's root element, space-separated. Default: none.

keyBindings.description: Override default key combos. Keys are action names, values are combo strings.

onSort.description: Sent when "sort" emits. Its payload (a record) is at <eventData path>/sort.

onPage.description: Sent when "page" emits. Its payload (a record) is at <eventData path>/page.

onActivate.description: Sent when "activate" emits. Its payload (a record) is at <eventData path>/activate.

onCellEdit.description: Sent when "cellEdit" emits. Its payload (a record) is at <eventData path>/cellEdit.

DatePicker.description: Date Picker. Let the user pick one calendar date from a popup calendar, with optional limits. For a date and a time use DateTimeInput; for a fiscal month or quarter use PeriodPicker. Use it to edit, schedule a scalar of exactly 1 item.

value.description: Initial selected date. Defaults to today. Two-way: when bound to a path, the component writes the user's changes there. When the user clears it, the path is deleted; delete the path to clear it, or leave it absent to start empty.

firstDayOfWeek.description: First day of the week: 0 = Sunday … 6 = Saturday. Default: 0.

showWeekNumbers.description: Show ISO week numbers in the left column. Default: false.

showTodayButton.description: Show the "Today" button in the footer. Default: true.

disabledDates.description: Specific dates that cannot be selected.

disabled.description: When true, the component is disabled. Default: false.

readonly.description: When true, input is not editable but calendar works. Default: false.

locale.description: BCP 47 language tag for month and day names, such as "en-US" or "fr-FR". Default: "en-US".

showFormatHint.description: Show format hint below input. Default: true.

showFormatHelp.description: Show format help icon. Default: true.

keyBindings.description: Override default key combos. Keys are action names, values are combo strings.

DocViewer.description: Doc Viewer. Show multi-page documentation written in markdown, with a table of contents, an outline and previous and next links. For one short piece of text use Text; for switching between a few panels use Tabs. Use it to browse, inspect a document of 1 to 500 items.

showToc.description: Show left TOC panel. Default: true.

showOutline.description: Show right outline panel. Default: true.

tocWidth.description: TOC panel width in px. Default: 260.

outlineWidth.description: Outline panel width in px. Default: 220.

DurationPicker.description: Duration Picker. Let the user enter a length of time in units such as days, hours and minutes. For a time of day use TimePicker; for a recurring schedule use CronPicker.

pattern.description:
The unit pattern determining which spinner columns are shown.
A hyphen-separated string of unit identifiers.
Default: "h-m".

value.description: Initial duration value. Defaults to all zeros. Two-way: when bound to a path, the component writes the user's changes there.

unitSteps.description: Step increment for each unit. Default: 1 for all units.

unitMax.description: Maximum value for each unit. Uses natural range defaults if not specified.

carry.description: When true, overflowing a subordinate unit carries into the next larger unit. Default: false.

hideZeroLeading.description: Hide leading zero-value units in the display. Default: true.

showClearButton.description: Show the "Clear" button in the dropdown footer. Default: true.

showFormatHint.description: Show the ISO 8601 format hint below the input. Default: true.

showFormatHelp.description: Show the format help icon and tooltip. Default: true.

formatHelpText.description: Custom help text for the format tooltip.

disabled.description: When true, the input is disabled. Default: false.

readonly.description: When true, the input is not editable by typing but dropdown works. Default: false.

placeholder.description: Placeholder text when duration is zero.

keyBindings.description: Override default key combos. Keys are action names, values are combo strings.

DynamicFormSwitcher.description: Dynamic Form Switcher. Show a form whose fields the agent defines, optionally in several variants the user switches between; read the values from eventData. For one or two inputs use TextField or ChoicePicker; for a fixed set of choices use ChoicePicker. Use it to edit, author a record of exactly 1 item.

variants.description:
The forms, keyed by variant id. Each has a label and a list of fields;
a field has a name (its key in the values), a label and a type, and
optionally a placeholder, help text, options (for select and radio),
an initial value and whether it is required.

label.description: The variant's name in the selector.

icon.description: Bootstrap Icons class.

name.description: The field's key in the values.

placeholder.description: Shown while the field is empty.

required.description: The field must be filled in.

value.description: Initial value.

options.description: Choices for select, multiselect and radio.

showSelector.description: Shows a control for choosing the variant. Default: false.

selectorStyle.description: How the variant control looks: "dropdown", "segmented" or "tabs". Default: "dropdown".

selectorHelpText.description: Help text under the variant control.

value.description: Initial values: field name to value for the shown variant, or variant id to such a map for several.

retainStateAcrossSwitches.description: Keeps each variant's values when the user switches away and back. Default: true.

size.description: Maximum width: "sm", "md", "lg", "xl", or "auto" for the container's width. Default: "auto".

className.description: Extra CSS classes on the root element.

onChange.description: Sent when "change" emits. Its payload (a record) is at <eventData path>/change.

EditableComboBox.description: Editable Combo Box. Let the user type freely or pick from a filtered list of suggestions in one field. To choose only from a fixed list use ChoicePicker; for a search query use SearchBox.

items.description: The items to display in the dropdown.

placeholder.description: Placeholder text shown when the input is empty.

value.description: Initial value of the input. If it matches an item, that item is selected. Two-way: when bound to a path, the component writes the user's changes there.

restrictToItems.description: When true, only values from the item list are accepted. Default: false.

maxVisibleItems.description: Maximum number of visible items before the dropdown scrolls. Default: 8.

minFilterLength.description: Minimum characters before filtering begins. Default: 0.

disabled.description: When true, the input and toggle are disabled. Default: false.

readonly.description: When true, the input is not editable but the dropdown can still open. Default: false.

keyBindings.description: Override default key combos. Keys are action names, values are combo strings.

EmptyState.description: Empty State. Fill an empty view with an icon, a heading, a short explanation and up to two buttons, such as Create project. For a loading placeholder use SkeletonLoader; for a single call to action without the empty message use Button. Use it to browse a collection of exactly 0 items.

icon.description: Bootstrap Icons class. Default: "bi-inbox".

iconColor.description: CSS colour for icon. Default: uses $gray-400 via class.

compact.description: Reduced padding for panels. Default: false.

cssClass.description: Additional CSS class(es) on root.

onAction.description: Sent when "action" emits. Its payload (a scalar) is at <eventData path>/action.

onSecondary.description: Sent when "secondary" emits. Its payload (a scalar) is at <eventData path>/secondary.

ExplorerPicker.description: Explorer Picker. Let the user browse and search a folder tree and pick items to link or attach; you answer each folder's children and, if you bind onSearch, each search. To pick from a short flat list use ChoicePicker; for a tree the user only browses or edits use TreeView or TreeGrid.

mode.description: "single" picks one node (double-click confirms it); "multi" picks several with checkboxes. Default "single".

selectionTarget.description: Which nodes can be picked: resources (assets and links), containers (org units and folders), or any.

resourceTypeFilter.description: Resource type keys to show; other resources are hidden, containers always show. Child types match too.

excludeNodeIds.description: Node ids shown dimmed and not selectable, such as the resource being linked from.

preSelectedNodeIds.description: Node ids selected when the picker opens.

searchPlaceholder.description: Placeholder of the search box. Default "Search resources..." ("Search folders..." for containers).

emptySearchMessage.description: Message shown when a search finds nothing. Default "No results found.".

emptyTreeMessage.description: Message shown when the tree has no nodes. Default "No resources found.".

height.description: CSS height of the picker, such as "400px". Default "400px".

cssClass.description: Extra CSS classes for the root element, separated by single spaces.

ontologyTypes.description: Resource types with their icons and colours, used instead of loading them from ontologyApiBase.

key.description: The resource type key nodes name in resourceType.

icon.description: Bootstrap Icons class for resources of this type.

color.description: The icon's colour, as #RGB or #RRGGBB hex, such as "#2E7D32".

parentTypeKey.description: The parent type's key; resourceTypeFilter matches a type through its parents.

isExternal.description: True for a resource held outside, which shows an external badge.

confirmButtonText.description: Confirm button label. Default "Select" or "Select (N selected)"; host code may pass a function of the count.

staticNodes.description:
The initial tree, as a flat list in which each node names its parentId (null for a root). With it, the
tree, the ontology and the recent and starred items are not requested; expanding a node and searching
still request apiBase unless onLoadChildren and onSearch answer them.

id.description: Unique node id; selections, expansion and parentId refer to it.

nodeType.description: ORG_UNIT and FOLDER are containers; ASSET_REF and LINK are resources.

resourceId.description: The resource this node points at, returned in the selection.

resourceType.description: The resource's type key: shown as a badge, and matched by resourceTypeFilter and ontologyTypes.

sourceId.description: The resource's source system id, returned in the selection.

url.description: The resource's URL, returned in the selection; never rendered as a link.

linkType.description: A LINK's kind (google_docs, sharepoint, confluence, github), which picks its default icon.

hasChildren.description: True when the node has children, so it shows an expand toggle. Without its children in staticNodes, expanding it sends onLoadChildren.

icon.description: Bootstrap Icons class for a resource (e.g. "bi-file-earmark-code"); containers keep their folder icons.

parentId.description: The id of the node's parent, or null for a root.

breadcrumb.description: A path shown under a search result.

cancellable.description: Show the Cancel button even without onCancel. Default false.

showSearch.description: Show the search box. Default true.

onConfirm.description: Sent when "confirm" emits. Its payload (one or more collections) is at <eventData path>/confirm.

onCancel.description: Sent when "cancel" emits. Its payload (one or more collections) is at <eventData path>/cancel.

onLoadChildren.description: Sent when the component needs "loadChildren" answered. Its request is at <eventData path>/loadChildren. Answer with updateDataModel at the path bound to loadChildrenResult.

loadChildrenResult.description: Bind to the path you will answer onLoadChildren at with updateDataModel, and write a value matching #/$defs/ExplorerPicker__loadChildrenResult there. A literal cannot answer a request.

onSearch.description: Sent when the component needs "search" answered. Its request is at <eventData path>/search. Answer with updateDataModel at the path bound to searchResult.

searchResult.description: Bind to the path you will answer onSearch at with updateDataModel, and write a value matching #/$defs/ExplorerPicker__searchResult there. A literal cannot answer a request.

FacetSearch.description: Facet Search. Let the user search with free text plus key:value filters picked from known facets; the agent hears each search. For plain text search use SearchBox; for picking from a fixed list use ChoicePicker.

facets.description: The facets the user can search by (key, label, value type). Required; pass [] for free-text only.

value.description: Initial query string, parsed into chips and free text, e.g. "status:open hello". Default: empty. Two-way: when bound to a path, the component writes the user's changes there.

placeholder.description: Placeholder text of the input. Default: "Search...".

showFacetChips.description: Turns recognised key:value pairs into removable chips. Default: true.

showHistory.description: Lists recent submitted searches in the dropdown when the input is empty. Default: false.

maxHistory.description: Most recent searches kept when showHistory is on. Default: 10.

submitOnEnter.description: Pressing Enter submits the search (fires onSearch and the "search" channel). Default: true.

clearOnSubmit.description: Clears the chips and input after each submitted search. Default: false.

disabled.description: Starts the search bar disabled (input not editable). Default: false.

cssClass.description: Extra CSS class added to the root element. Default: none.

FontDropdown.description: Font Dropdown. Let the user choose a font family from a list that previews each font in its own typeface. For choices that are not fonts use ChoicePicker; for a free-text font name use TextField.

fonts.description: Custom font list; defaults to curated Google + system fonts if omitted.

value.description: Initially selected font value. Two-way: when bound to a path, the component writes the user's changes there.

placeholder.description: Placeholder text when no font is selected.

showRecent.description: Show recently-used fonts section. Default: false.

maxRecent.description: Maximum number of recent fonts to remember. Default: 5.

previewText.description: Optional preview text shown beside each font name.

maxVisibleItems.description: Max visible items before scrolling. Default: 8.

groupByCategory.description: Group fonts by category headers. Default: true for default fonts.

keyBindings.description: Override default keyboard bindings.

Gauge.description: Gauge. Show a value against a maximum, a limit or a deadline as a ring, bar or tile gauge with coloured thresholds. For a number with a trend and no scale use MetricCard; for a value the user drags use RangeSlider. Use it to monitor a scalar of exactly 1 item.

shape.description: Visual shape of the gauge. Required.

mode.description: Data mode: "value" for numeric, "time" for countdown. Default: "value".

value.description: Current value. Default: 0.

targetDate.description: Target date for countdown. Required when mode is "time".

autoTick.description: Enable auto-tick timer. Default: true when targetDate is set.

title.description: Gauge title/name (shown in tile footer or ring/bar label).

subtitle.description: Subtitle text (shown below value in tile).

size.description: Predefined size or explicit pixel value. Omit for fluid.

thresholds.description: Colour thresholds sorted ascending by value.

invertThresholds.description: If true, lower percentage = worse (e.g., remaining). Default: false.

overLimitColor.description: Colour when value exceeds max. Default: "#dc3545".

overLimitLabel.description: Label for over-limit state. Default: "Over Limit".

overdueColor.description: Colour when target date has passed. Default: "#dc3545".

cssClass.description: Additional CSS classes on the root element.

ariaLabel.description: Accessible label for screen readers. Auto-generated if omitted.

GradientPicker.description: Gradient Picker. Let the user design a linear or radial colour gradient with stops, an angle and presets. For a single solid colour use ColorPicker.

value.description: Initial gradient value. Two-way: when bound to a path, the component writes the user's changes there.

popupPosition.description: Popup position relative to trigger. Default: "bottom-start".

showTypeToggle.description: Show gradient type toggle (linear/radial). Default: true.

showAngle.description: Show angle control (linear mode). Default: true.

showRadialControls.description: Show centre/radius controls (radial mode). Default: true.

GraphLegend.description: Graph Legend. Explain the node and edge types of a graph or diagram, with colours, icons and optional counts. For a plain key-value list use List with Text; it is not a legend for numeric chart series.

showEdgeTypes.description: Show the edge types section. Default: true.

showCounts.description: Show count badges next to types. Default: false.

InlineToolbar.description: Inline Toolbar. Show a compact row of icon buttons and toggles, such as text formatting; the agent hears which one the user pressed. For a single action use Button; for a choice among options use ChoicePicker.

size.description: Button height: xs=24px, sm=28px, md=32px. Default: "sm".

compact.description: Reduce gaps for tight spaces. Default: false.

onItemClick.description: Sent when "itemClick" emits. Its payload (a record) is at <eventData path>/itemClick.

LatexEditor.description: LaTeX Editor. Let the user write a LaTeX math expression with a live rendered preview and a symbol palette; Ctrl+Enter confirms. For prose use RichTextInput; for code use CodeEditor.

value.description:
Alias of `expression` — provided to satisfy the DynamicFormSwitcher
field-capable component convention (AGENTS.md). When both are set,
`expression` wins. Two-way: when bound to a path, the component writes the user's changes there.

displayMode.description: Display mode (block) or inline mode. Default: true (display).

showToolbar.description: Show the styling toolbar. Default: true.

showSymbolPalette.description: Show the symbol palette. Default: true.

showPreview.description: Show the live preview pane. Default: true.

contained.description: Contained mode (for DiagramEngine embedding). Default: false.

cssClass.description: Additional CSS class on root element.

enableChemistry.description: Enable mhchem chemistry extension. Default: true.

LayoutPicker.description: Layout Picker. Let the user choose an automatic layout algorithm for a graph or diagram, shown as thumbnails. For choices that are not layout algorithms use ChoicePicker.

value.description: Initial selected algorithm ID. Two-way: when bound to a path, the component writes the user's changes there.

algorithms.description: Array of algorithm IDs to include (default: all).

groupByCategory.description: Group items by category with headers (default: false).

showCategoryAccent.description: Show category colour accent on thumbnails (default: true).

ribbonMode.description: Compact ribbon-mode trigger (22px, no thumbnail). Default: false.

customAlgorithms.description: Custom algorithms to register beyond the built-in set.

LineEndingPicker.description: Line Ending Picker. Let the user choose an arrowhead or other end marker for a line or connector in a diagram. For a line's dash pattern use LineTypePicker; for its thickness use LineWidthPicker.

endings.description: Custom endings list; defaults to 12 standard markers if omitted.

value.description: Initially selected ending value. Two-way: when bound to a path, the component writes the user's changes there.

mode.description: Which end of the line receives the marker. Default: "end".

previewStrokeWidth.description: Preview stroke width in pixels. Default: 2.

maxVisibleItems.description: Max visible items before scrolling. Default: 8.

showERNotation.description: Append ER notation endings when no custom endings are provided.

LineShapePicker.description: Line Shape Picker. Let the user choose the routing shape of a connector in a diagram, such as straight or curved. For a line's dash pattern use LineTypePicker; for its end markers use LineEndingPicker.

shapes.description: Custom shape list; defaults to 6 maxGraph routing styles if omitted.

value.description: Initially selected shape value. Two-way: when bound to a path, the component writes the user's changes there.

previewStrokeWidth.description: Preview stroke width in pixels. Default: 2.

maxVisibleItems.description: Max visible items before scrolling. Default: 8.

LineTypePicker.description: Line Type Picker. Let the user choose a line's dash pattern, such as solid, dashed or dotted, with a preview. For a line's thickness use LineWidthPicker; for its routing shape use LineShapePicker.

types.description: Custom type list; defaults to 12 common dash patterns if omitted.

value.description: Initially selected type name (e.g. "dashed"). Two-way: when bound to a path, the component writes the user's changes there.

previewStrokeWidth.description: Preview stroke width in pixels. Default: 2.

maxVisibleItems.description: Max visible items before scrolling. Default: 8.

LineWidthPicker.description: Line Width Picker. Let the user choose a line or border thickness from a list that previews each width. For a line's dash pattern use LineTypePicker; for an arbitrary number use Slider.

widths.description: Custom width list; defaults to 13 common widths if omitted.

value.description: Initially selected width value. Two-way: when bound to a path, the component writes the user's changes there.

maxVisibleItems.description: Max visible items before scrolling. Default: 8.

LogConsole.description: Log Console. Show a scrolling log of timestamped messages with level filters, such as a build or job output. For a timeline of user actions use ActivityFeed; for an audit trail use AuditLogViewer.

entries.description: Entries to show from the start, oldest first; each also reaches onEntry.

maxEntries.description: Maximum entries kept in memory and DOM. Default: 500.

showHeader.description: Show header bar with filter chips, Clear, Export. Default: true.

autoScroll.description: Auto-scroll to newest entry. Default: true.

exportFilenamePrefix.description: Filename prefix for text export downloads. Default: "logs".

fontFamily.description: Font family for all text. Default: monospace stack.

height.description: CSS height for the root element. Default: "100%".

cssClass.description: Additional CSS class(es) on the root element.

contained.description: Contained mode — relative positioning for parent embedding. Default: false.

MarginsPicker.description: Margins Picker. Let the user choose page margins from named presets such as Normal, Narrow and Wide. For paper size use SizesPicker; for line and paragraph spacing use SpacingPicker.

value.description: Initial selected preset name. Default: "Normal". Two-way: when bound to a path, the component writes the user's changes there.

presets.description: Custom preset definitions. Overrides defaults if provided.

showCustom.description: Show "Custom Margins..." link at bottom. Default: true.

ribbonMode.description: Render as ribbon-compatible dropdown. Default: true.

onCustom.description: Sent when "custom" emits. Its payload (a scalar) is at <eventData path>/custom.

MarkdownEditor.description: Markdown Editor. Let the user write and preview a markdown document, with a formatting toolbar; Ctrl+Enter saves. For a short formatted note use RichTextInput; to show markdown read-only use DocViewer. Use it to author, edit a document of exactly 1 item.

value.description: Initial markdown content. Two-way: when bound to a path, the component writes the user's changes there.

mode.description:
Layout mode. Default "tabs".
"display" renders read-only markdown with no chrome. Suitable for hovers/popovers.
"naked" renders an editable Vditor surface with no chrome — feels like a textarea
that understands markdown. Has form-control border and CSS resize.

editable.description: Editing mode: true = readwrite, false = readonly. Default true.

title.description: Editor title shown in header bar.

showInlineToolbar.description: Show inline selection toolbar. Default true.

isolated.description: Scope display-mode styles to prevent CSS bleed. Default false.

compact.description: Tighter vertical spacing for embedded/sidebar contexts. Default false.

theme.description: Color theme for display mode. Default "light".

children.description: Child nodes. null means lazy-loadable; undefined/[] means no children.

lazy.description: When true and children is null, expand triggers onLoadChildren.

expanded.description: Whether this node starts expanded. Default: false.

disabled.description: When true, this node cannot be selected, expanded, or interacted with.

starred.description: Whether this node appears in the starred group.

tooltip.description: Native tooltip text for the node row.

data.description: Arbitrary consumer data passed back in callbacks.

TreeView__TreeNode.description:
Represents a single node in the tree.
The consumer owns this data; the TreeView reads but never mutates it
(except for expanded state tracking which is internal).

icon.description: Default Bootstrap Icons class for this kind.

isParent.description: Whether this kind can have children. Default: false.

renamable.description: Whether nodes of this kind can be renamed inline. Default: true.

draggable.description: Whether nodes of this kind can be dragged. Default: true.

droppable.description: Whether nodes of this kind accept drops. Default: true for parents.

contextMenuItems.description: Context menu items specific to this kind.

cssClass.description: Additional CSS class added to the node row.

TreeView__TreeNodeTypeDescriptor.description:
Describes the behaviour and appearance of a node kind.
Registered via options.nodeTypes.

VisualTableEditor__RecordstringVisualTab.description: Construct a type with a set of properties K of type T

value.description: Cell content — plain string or rich content array.

style.description: Inline style overrides for this content segment.

VisualTableEditor__VisualTableCellConten.description: Rich content segment within a cell.

align.description: Default horizontal alignment for cells in this column.

valign.description: Default vertical alignment for cells in this column.

resizable.description: Whether this column is resizable. Default: true.

VisualTableEditor__VisualTableData.description: The canonical data format for import/export.

headerRows.description: Number of header rows at the top. Default: 1.

headerColumns.description: Number of header columns on the left (frozen). Default: 0.

alternatingRows.description: Enable alternating row colours. Default: true.

alternatingRowColorDark.description:
Dark-mode alternating-row colour. Set from a preset's
`alternatingRowDark`. When present the row paints via a custom property
the stylesheet switches on `[data-bs-theme]`, so a theme toggle
repaints without a re-render (ADR-152).

alternatingColumns.description: Enable alternating column colours. Default: false.

defaultBackground.description: Default background for all cells. Default: "transparent".

defaultFontSize.description: Default font size in px. Default: 13.

footerAggregate.description: Footer aggregate type for each column. Default: none.

showSummaryBar.description: Show the summary bar. Default: false.

summaryBarAggregates.description: Which aggregates to show in the summary bar.

height.description: Row height in px. Optional (auto-sized if omitted).

cells.description: Cell data keyed by column ID.

title.description: Display title. Untrusted — rendered via textContent only.

pinned.description: Pinned canvases sort first and are visually marked.
